verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity exposes verification results programmatically via its API (JSON), which offers some data access in a machine-readable format, but there is no documentation of a full data-export tool, open-format bulk export, or an explicit account-closure/data-portability path for a user to leave with all their data. missing for 10: explicit open-format full data export, account deletion/portability guarantee, evidence of end-user (not just integrating business) data export.
